# Daily Life Hacks

> Practical nutrition tips, easy healthy recipes, and kitchen hacks for everyday life. Food-first, no supplements, no drama. Also home to original grocery nutrition economics data: which foods deliver the most fiber and protein per dollar in the US.

## Key facts

Each line quotes one number from the CSV named on that line. The source phrase is the `price_basis`, chain source, or FoodData Central id stored on that row. The study link is the live page (the two old flagship URLs now redirect).

- Dry pinto beans: 57.6 g protein per $1, BLS US average July 2026 (APU0000714233), FDC 175199. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/protein-per-dollar-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/protein-per-dollar-adjusted-for-quality/
- Dry pinto beans: 41.7 g fiber per $1, BLS US average July 2026 (APU0000714233), FDC 175199. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/fiber-per-dollar-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/what-30-grams-of-fiber-costs-per-day/
- Chia seeds: 34.4 g fiber per 100 g, FDC 170554, price basis Walmart GV. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/fiber-per-dollar-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/best-high-fiber-foods-ranked-by-fiber-content/
- Bone-in chicken drumsticks: 50.3 g protein per $1 after a 33% USDA refuse adjustment, Walmart Jul 2026, FDC 172373. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/animal-protein-per-dollar-ranked-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/protein-per-dollar-adjusted-for-quality/
- Large eggs: 34.4 g protein per $1, BLS US average July 2026 (APU0000708111), FDC 171287. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/dairy-protein-per-dollar-ranked-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/protein-per-dollar-adjusted-for-quality/
- Frozen green peas: 17.6 g fiber per $1, FDC 170016, price basis Walmart GV. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/produce-fiber-per-dollar-ranked-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/what-30-grams-of-fiber-costs-per-day/
- Old-fashioned rolled oats: 35.8 g fiber per $1, FDC 173904, price basis Walmart GV. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/grains-fiber-per-dollar-ranked-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/what-30-grams-of-fiber-costs-per-day/
- Chipotle High Protein Cup (4 oz chicken): 32 g protein, $3.82, 8.4 g protein per $1. Source: chipotle.com US nutrition facts. Price basis: Chipotle's published national weighted average at launch, Dec 2025 press release. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/fastfood-protein-per-dollar-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/fast-food-protein-per-dollar-ranked/
- Almonds: 1 mg sodium per 100 g and 0.7 mg sodium per $1, FDC 170567, price basis Walmart GV. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/sodium-per-dollar-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/low-sodium-budget-foods-ranked/
- Rock-bottom fiber day, rolled oats at breakfast: 6.1 g fiber and $0.17, FDC 173904. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/fiber-day-cost-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/what-30-grams-of-fiber-costs-per-day/
- Mixed protein day, two large eggs: 12.6 g protein and $0.37, FDC 171287. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/protein-day-cost-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/what-50-grams-of-protein-costs-per-day/
- Bone-in chicken drumsticks, quality-adjusted: 50.3 g usable protein per $1 after a DIAAS of 1.08 capped at 1.00 (Burd et al. 2019), FDC 172373. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/protein-quality-per-dollar-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/protein-per-dollar-adjusted-for-quality/
- TVP: 52.17 g protein per 100 g and 23.4 g protein per $1, Walmart/Bob's Red Mill Jul 2026. No FDC id. The row is the manufacturer label. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/protein-per-dollar-2026.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/foods-highest-in-protein-per-100-grams/
- All-purpose white flour, U.S. city average: 87.17 g protein per $1 on 2026-10-01, FDC 168894. CSV: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/bls-nutrition-per-dollar-latest.csv Study: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/methodology/

Full methodology: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/methodology/
Catalog: https://www.daily-life-hacks.com/data/
